performance.verdict: CPL crisis is real; but pipeline zero-won and overdue scoreboard are the deeper emergency.

findings.text: CPL spiked 49.4% in 7d on near-flat spend (-2.1%), while leads fell 34.5% — last 3 days (Sep 7–9) yielded only 7 leads vs 12 in the prior 3 (Sep 4–6), confirming deterioration is accelerating, not stabilising.

5 overdue SOW milestones (phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, dashboard, and Aug scoreboard trust — latest due 2026-08-31) are undelivered; client's stay/walk renewal decision is now past due with no scoreboard to show.
GHL shows 105 opportunities created (28d) but 0 won and 0 appointments — 102 leads arriving, none converting to chair; this is an intake leak, not an ads problem.

Single campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' consumed 100% of $749.28 (28d spend) with a retargeting-only audience; flat spend + falling leads on a retargeting-exclusive pool is textbook audience exhaustion.
GBP actions fell 61.67% week-over-week (to ~2 actions/day in the Sep 7–9 window vs 9+/day in late August), reducing the organic demand signal that retargeting pools depend on for replenishment.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; dashboard and scoreboard must be live before renewal conversation.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW deliverables are past their deadlines (latest: 2026-08-31), including the dashboard and August scoreboard that the client's stay/walk renewal decision depends on. Nacer must assign owners and due dates today. Success check: all 5 items marked complete in Monday with client confirmation by 2026-09-13. Without this, the renewal conversation has no evidence base.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake leak: 105 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — find where leads are stalling before escalating ad spend.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 leads and 105 opportunities in 28 days but zero won and zero appointments booked. This is not an ads problem — the funnel is breaking between lead arrival and scheduling. Pull the GHL pipeline stage breakdown with Ali Shaheer and Lily to identify where contacts are stalling. Success check: a stage-by-stage drop-off map exists and a fix is assigned by 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Introduce a cold/prospecting campaign alongside retargeting to replenish the exhausted audience pool; keep retargeting budget flat at ~$25/day.
suggestions.monday_update: The single retargeting campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' has consumed 100% of spend on a shrinking audience, producing a 49.4% CPL spike and 34.5% lead drop over 7 days. Add a prospecting campaign (new creative, cold audience) at ~$10–15/day while holding retargeting flat at ~$25/day. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $7.35 and leads recover to 4+/day within 7 days of launch, measured by 2026-09-17.
